definition: the result you plan and work toward
description: Inside an indoor climbing hall, a young woman in a green top and black shorts leaps off the wall with one arm stretched up and grabs the big yellow hold at the very top of the steep grey climbing wall, chalk dust puffing from her hand. She hangs from it with her legs swinging. On the blue padded floor below, three friends in sports clothes watch, then throw their arms up and cheer. More climbers stand near a counter, and colourful holds cover the walls under a high roof.
